target_zone_range.evidence_basis: Current Kew accepts O. biennis as native to Texas, but this pass did not lock three exact target-zone counties. The project's single wild observation is not enough to infer county-wide native status.
target_zone_range.guardrail: Exact county evidence only; historical Gaura/Calylophus names are counted only after synonym reconciliation.

morphology.look_here_first: Treat as a tall biennial evening-primrose comparison. It typically forms a first-year rosette, then an erect flowering stem with yellow 4-petaled evening-opening flowers and an elongate capsule.

comparisons.key_distinctions: Much taller and more erect than low O. laciniata or spreading O. capillifolia; do not count as local without exact county evidence.
